correctness.rationale: All independent subsets and strict inclusion flags are enumerated for each \(6\le n\le20\). Quotient cells are legitimate after barycentric subdivision; signed boundaries satisfy d^2=0. Free-face collapses are certified on current full incidences and exhaust dimensions above 2, 3, or 4 as appropriate. Integral chain elimination uses 1-unit pivots and at n=20 leaves one degree-four to degree-three coefficient 2, with one additional free degree-three generator; independent modular ranks over 2 and 3 confirm that coefficient. All noncontractible fundamental group presentations reduce to the identity by valid finite Tietze moves. Hurewicz and homological Whitehead and the 4-cell Smith-normal-form argument establish the complete stated homotopy types. This proves only a finite range, not an extrapolation.
